ICS 77.140.15
CED 54
CED 54
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements and tests applicable to reinforcement couplers to be used in reinforced concrete constructions for mechanical splicing of reinforcement bars conforming to IS 1786.
1.2 The provisions of this standard applies to tension and tension-compression couplers subject to satisfying the performance criteria of this standard.
1.3 This standard does not cover compression-only couplers such as end bearing sleeves and coupling sleeve and wedge.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:
